messages:
nina: FYI — noticed a short spike in 5xx rate around ~1709987600 on prod. Can someone point me to the heatmap + sample traces so I can attach evidence to the postmortem? Also want to propose a slight alert window tweak. :eyes:
observability-bot: heatmap: https://dash.prod.internal/redwood/errors/heatmap?env=prod
traces: https://traces.prod.internal/query?service=gateway&time=1709987400-1709987700
kevin: Quick pointers — heatmap link above is the right one. For traces use the trace query and filter by http.status_code >= 500 + gateway. If you want raw request IDs, add "has:request_id" in the trace UI.
maya: If the spike was ~3m burst, can we consider bumping alert window to 10m with a 3/5 evaluation (3m lookback, 5m sliding) so small blips don't paged? My concern is frequent noisy pages during deploys.
ajay: Can someone paste a couple request_ids from the top span? I’ll pull logs quickly. Example curl to fetch log by id:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOG_TOKEN" 
  "https://logs.prod.internal/search?q=request_id:abc123&from=1709987400&to=1709987800"
```
kevin: I grabbed two samples: req=4f2c9a, req=8b7d1f — both show 504 from upstream timeout, route /v1/generate. Adding them to the incident note.
nina: thanks — that matches what I saw in the gateway SLO dashboard. Maya, for the alert change proposal I suggest: 
- change alert to fire if error_rate > 0.8% for 3/5 evaluation window
- keep notify-to-channel but only page on sustained >1.5% for 15m
- add runbook link in alert text with quick triage steps and the heatmap traces links

maya: +1 to the runbook link. Also add a note to check prefix cache saturation (ingress timeouts) before rolling back models.
infra-bot: Deploy bot ping — there was a small deploy to gateway-prod at 1709987500, user: deployer-bot. Might correlate.
ajay: I'll annotate the traces and add the two request_ids to the log thread. If we want, I can draft a PR to adjust alert eval and page thresholds and run it by SRE.
kevin: If you do the PR, include metric query and dashboard snapshot. For metric queries use: ```
rollup(sum:http_errors{service:gateway}.as_count(), "1m") / rollup(sum:requests{service:gateway}.as_count(), "1m")
```
then apply the evaluation window on top.
nina: Perfect. I'll update the incident note with links and the proposed alert text, and @ajay please open the PR. Thanks all :+1:
